question: What data separation and regressions should the internal policy repair use?

criteria.instruction: Keep per-component origin/version/attribution/class/offer records separate from deduplicated notice texts. Select only distributed components, validate complete required fields and digest/text consistency before replacement. Test shared text/distinct owners, unselected installed components, missing S offer, conflicting digest/text and failure preserving prior g4.
Ground controls in D22 and repair review with v15's global offer/digest overwrite flaws.
Do not change release selection, publish a bundle or claim real legal approval merely to satisfy fixture validation.
